market_pulse.note: About $64,200 early Tuesday, down about 1% since midnight UTC (CoinDesk); CoinCodex showed $64,838, up 0.53% over 24 hours, at 6:00 UTC. It remains below its 200-week average near $68,000.
About $1,812 early Tuesday, down 0.4% since midnight UTC (CoinDesk); CoinCodex showed $1,833, up 1.22% over 24 hours, at 6:00 UTC.
About $2.19 trillion, up 0.46% over 24 hours, with trading volume up about 18% to $68.45 billion (CoinCodex).

themes.title: ETF outflow streak ends
themes.summary: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs took in a net $7.9 million Monday, ending a seven-day outflow streak; BlackRock's IBIT drew $76.5 million while Grayscale's GBTC lost $34.6 million (CoinDesk, citing Farside).

themes.title: Bounce stalls below $65,000
themes.summary: Bitcoin's rebound from a weekend low near $62,000 has stalled; it is down about 12% over seven days and about 21% over 30 days (CoinDesk; Kryptoliczby).

themes.title: Sentiment still at extreme fear
themes.summary: CoinMarketCap's Fear and Greed Index read 13, up from 12, and the alternative.me index was 12 (CoinDesk; CoinGabbar).

themes.title: Stablecoin supply shrinking
themes.summary: Total stablecoin supply fell 5.3% over 30 days to about $284.2 billion, the steepest drop since 2022, according to DefiLlama data (CoinDesk).

themes.title: Rate-hike bets weigh on crypto
themes.summary: Wintermute said Bitcoin could slide into the $50,000s, citing a roughly 92% priced chance of a December Fed hike and 10-year yields above 5%; Kalshi traders put the odds at 89% (CoinDesk; CoinGabbar).

categories.name: Majors (BTC/ETH)
categories.note: Little changed over 24 hours, with Bitcoin near $64,200–$64,800 and Ether near $1,812–$1,833 depending on the snapshot (CoinDesk; CoinCodex).

categories.name: Altcoins
categories.note: Breadth improved, with about 89% of tracked coins higher over 24 hours; the CoinDesk 20 index rose about 1.7%, and SOL gained about 3.9% (CoinCodex; CoinDesk).

categories.name: Derivatives
categories.note: Futures volume rose 29.7% to $179.8 billion and open interest rose 3% to $111 billion; funding stayed negative for most coins, and liquidations totaled $279.6 million (CoinDesk).

categories.name: DeFi and Security
categories.note: DeFi market cap was about $59.4 billion, up 3.6%; a Gnosis Safe wallet lost about $6.45 million, and a Trezor partner breach exposed data from 27,000 orders (CoinGabbar).

watch_list.why: Nvidia reports after the U.S. close, its first results since Jensen Huang resigned, following a 2.5% drop in the Nasdaq on Monday (CoinDesk; Yahoo Finance).
October U.S. retail sales are due Tuesday and the October Fed minutes Wednesday at 2 p.m. ET; the next Fed meeting is Dec. 8–9 (CoinGabbar; CoinDesk).
Bitcoin trades about 5% below its 200-week average; Monday's weekend low was near $62,000, and options activity is concentrated on Nov. 27 and Dec. 25 expiries (CoinDesk; Kryptoliczby).

movers.name: Telcoin (TEL)
movers.note: Top 24-hour gainer as of 6:00 UTC Tuesday (CoinCodex).

movers.name: Hyperliquid (HYPE)
movers.note: Among the strongest large caps on CoinDesk's ticker, though it later traded lower intraday (CoinDesk).

movers.name: Rain (RAIN)
movers.note: Gave back part of Monday's roughly 95% gain on low volume (CoinDesk).

movers.name: Ultima (ULTIMA)
movers.note: Biggest 24-hour decliner on CoinCodex's list, a day after leading gainers (CoinCodex).
